title: F12-to-K12 Functor Dictionary

phase_to_rotation_system_test.phase_bucket_rule: bucket phase labels by cyclic distance d=(j-i) mod 12

verdict: The functor is exact on objects, edges, and incidence. Phase labels can encode cyclic distance/current data, but distance-6 antipodal ties require an extra orientation gauge.
boundary: Functor is combinatorial/incidence-level; it is not a homeomorphism from optical chip geometry to a polyhedral surface.
